question.text: In the SEBI vs SKSE Securities Limited case, which of the following was NOT an allegation?

answer.text: Failure to maintain minimum net worth requirements
Failure to categorize clients into high, medium, and low risk categories
Delayed appointment of Principal Officer and delayed intimation to FIU

explanation.text: The Logic: The three allegations against SKSE Securities were: (1) not implementing AML mechanism, (2) not categorizing clients into high/medium/low risk, and (3) delayed appointment of Principal Officer (2 years late) and delayed intimation to FIU. Net worth requirements were NOT part of this case. The Trap: All three actual violations are listed as distractors. The case was specifically about AML compliance failures, not financial adequacy requirements.
